title.en: Borrowed, Then Changed: India Among the World's Constitutions
title.hi: लिया भी, बदला भी: दूसरे संविधानों से भारत की तुलना

sources.name: Constituent Assembly Debates, 4 November 1948, Dr B. R. Ambedkar moving the Draft Constitution (constitutionofindia.net)
sources.what: Reply to the copying charge ('so late in the day', no patent rights, 1935 Act details); stability vs responsibility, American and Swiss vs British executive, daily and periodic assessment; dual polity with single citizenship vs US dual citizenship; US States frame own constitutions vs single frame; Australia 39 concurrent subjects vs 37 in Draft; Parliament legislating on State subjects of national concern after upper House resolution

sources.name: Constitution of India, Article 248 (Draft Article 223), constitutionofindia.net
sources.what: Parliament's exclusive residuary power, including taxes not in either List

sources.name: PRS Legislative Research, Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024
sources.what: Introduced in Lok Sabha December 2024; simultaneous elections to Lok Sabha and State Assemblies; referred to Joint Parliamentary Committee

sources.name: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2018, GS Paper I, question 38, with UPSC answer key (kit pyq.json)
sources.what: Residuary powers under the Government of India Act 1935 federation: Governor General (official key)

q.en: In Ambedkar's comparison, which system gives more stability but less responsibility?
q.hi: आंबेडकर की तुलना में कौन सी व्यवस्था ज़्यादा स्थिरता पर कम उत्तरदायित्व देती है?

why.en: The American executive does not depend on a majority in the legislature; the British system gives more responsibility.
why.hi: अमेरिकी कार्यपालिका विधायिका के बहुमत पर टिकी नहीं होती; ब्रिटिश व्यवस्था ज़्यादा उत्तरदायित्व देती है।

q.en: India's single citizenship was contrasted with dual citizenship in which federation?
q.hi: भारत की एकल नागरिकता की तुलना किस संघ की दोहरी नागरिकता से की गई थी?

why.en: The United States has a citizenship of the country and of the State.
why.hi: अमेरिका में देश की भी नागरिकता है और राज्य की भी।

q.en: Under Article 248, who holds residuary legislative power?
q.hi: अनुच्छेद 248 के तहत अवशिष्ट विधायी शक्ति किसके पास है?

why.en: Parliament. Under the Government of India Act 1935 it had been the Governor General.
why.hi: संसद। भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935 में यह गवर्नर जनरल के पास थी।

factsToCheck: The usual 'borrowed features' chart (e.g. Directive Principles from Ireland, emergency provisions from Germany) was left out: the NCERT chapter could not be downloaded today
The PRS page gives the bill's status as referred to a JPC; whether the JPC has reported by November 2026 was not separately confirmed
UPSC source URL points to the UPSC home page; the paper and key are as recorded in the kit pyq.json
Supporters' and critics' arguments on simultaneous elections are stated generally, not from an opened report
notes: Built around Ambedkar's 4 November 1948 speech, so all foreign comparisons are those he made. Simultaneous elections bill presented with both sides, no party named; not used in recall. Stays off the federalism mechanics (Union-State lists in detail) left to gs2-2 lines.
